$comment: L1-WP13a (planset v060, lanes/L1_AGENT_RUNTIME.md WP13): the ACP agents Core can run, pinned with dated evidence. Every row was checked on checked_at against the publisher's own source (npm registry, GitHub release, the ACP registry entry at evidence.acp_registry.commit). Nothing here is installable yet: delivery is a signed component download after the W0 signing ceremony (owner answer L1-Q2), and every row stays vetted=vetting until its citrate-security record (L1-WP15) says otherwise. sha256 values are of the artifact named by url; npm_integrity is the registry's own dist.integrity, re-computed locally for the npm tarballs on checked_at. Ids are the AgentId values agent_auth.rs knows (one LAYOUTS row each).

agents.label: Hermes
agents.acp_evidence: Hermes does not speak ACP yet: L1-WP07 adds agent-sidecar --acp in citrate-agent-runtime.
agents.installable_reason: built from source as the hermes-sidecar component (release/components.json); ACP mode not built yet

agents.label: Codex
agents.acp_evidence: ACP registry entry codex-acp 2.12.1 (npx @agentclientprotocol/codex-acp@2.12.1); dist/index.js offers authMethods api-key, chat-gpt, chat-gpt-device-code and gateway (only when the client advertises auth._meta.gateway).
agents.installable_reason: signed component download waits on the W0 signing ceremony (L1-Q2)
notes: The adapter is now a Node package that drives @openai/codex (range ^0.172.0, pinned here to 0.172.0); the lane file's 'native binary' row is out of date.
@zed-industries/codex-acp is deprecated on npm and github.com/zed-industries/codex-acp is archived (last release v0.16.0, 2026-06-08).
GitHub reports the repo license as NOASSERTION; the LICENSE file in the npm tarball is Apache-2.0 (Copyright 2025 JetBrains s.r.o.).
Proxy mode needs /v1/responses (L1-WP10, not built); the gateway auth method carries a base URL and headers over ACP authenticate, which fits a Citrate route token.

agents.label: Claude Agent
agents.acp_evidence: ACP registry entry claude-acp 0.113.0 (binary and npx @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp@0.113.0).
agents.license: Apache-2.0 adapter; @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3.331 under Anthropic terms (SEE LICENSE IN README.md)
agents.installable_reason: signed component download waits on the W0 signing ceremony (L1-Q2); API key only through the Citrate proxy (L1-Q3), which needs /v1/messages (L1-WP12, not built)
notes: The ACP registry lists the entry's license as proprietary because of the bundled Claude Agent SDK; the adapter's own LICENSE is Apache-2.0.
@zed-industries/claude-code-acp and @zed-industries/claude-agent-acp are deprecated on npm in favour of @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp.

agents.label: Gemini CLI
agents.acp_evidence: ACP registry entry gemini 0.71.1 (npx @google/gemini-cli@0.71.1 --acp); the bundle defines --acp and marks --experimental-acp deprecated.
agents.installable_reason: signed component download waits on the W0 signing ceremony (L1-Q2); needs the pinned Node runtime component (L1-Q3)
notes: engines.node >= 20. Home from GEMINI_CLI_HOME; tokens in a file when GEMINI_FORCE_FILE_STORAGE is set.

agents.label: goose
agents.acp_evidence: ACP registry entry goose 1.61.1 (binary, args acp); the v1.61.1 release also ships goose-acp-* archives.
agents.installable_reason: signed component download waits on the W0 signing ceremony (L1-Q2); Codex and goose are bundled only if the ceremony slips
notes: github.com/block/goose now redirects to github.com/aaif-goose/goose; release URLs under block/goose still resolve.

agents.label: Grok Build
agents.acp_evidence: ACP registry entry grok-build 1.0.94 (npx @xai-official/grok@1.0.94 agent stdio); not quarantined.
agents.license: unclear: npm license field Apache-2.0, no LICENSE file in the tarball, ACP registry says proprietary (https://x.ai/legal/terms-of-service)
agents.installable_reason: license unclear for redistribution; signed component download waits on the W0 signing ceremony (L1-Q2)
notes: The npm package runs a postinstall script (node bin/postinstall.js) and ships its native binary through optionalDependencies.

agents.label: Muse Code
agents.acp_evidence: ACP registry entry muse-code 1.4.24 (binary, args acp, env MUSE_EXPERIMENTAL_ACP=on).
agents.installable_reason: proprietary license (redistribution needs Meta's terms); ACP mode is experimental; signed component download waits on the W0 signing ceremony (L1-Q2)
notes: sha256 values are the ACP registry's; the binaries were not downloaded on checked_at.
